'''October 2000 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in KK's Komics, Kards, & Kollectibles, Pleasanton, CA on 28 October 2000. [[Clayton Atkin]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-pleasanton-ca-10-28-00d1396/ pleasanton-ca-10-28-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 29 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-pleasanton-ca-10-28-00d1396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 October 2000
* '''Site:''' KK's Komics, Kards, & Kollectibles, Pleasanton, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 19
* '''Winner:''' [[Clayton Atkin]]
